patterns.rationale: U+180E (Mongolian Vowel Separator, codepoint 0x180E) has no legitimate use in English technical documentation. Its sole appearance in this payload is as an inter-character obfuscation splitter. A single character match is maximally precise — it catches every variant of MVS-obfuscated tool names, commands, and keywords without any keyword enumeration. The known-good corpus is entirely English prose; none of those documents could contain this character.
patterns.fp_notes: Would fire on genuine Mongolian-script content, but that case is outside the threat model (English-language agent tool calls). No known benign English tech doc uses U+180E.
